description: The full grade overview (cijferoverzicht) for a school year: every subject with every result per period, report grades, weights and remarks. Defaults to the current placement; schooljaar like 2025/2026 picks another year. Use this for a whole-year report view or earlier years; use subject_grades for one subject, grades_latest for recent results.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.
